 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.393/2019 registered at PS Shakarpur under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that parties have settled their disputes vide settlement deed dated 07th June, 2021 arrived at with the facilitation of Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, which is on record of this Court.
The terms of the settlement are noted in the said statement recorded before the Delhi Mediation Centre.
2. Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2/complainant were married as per Islamic Rites and Customs on 25th March, 2017.
There is no issue from their wedlock.
Due to disputes and differences, the marriage has resulted in a divorce vide Talaqnama.
3. The petitioner No.1 is present in Court and duly identified by the counsel and the IO.
Respondent No.2 appears through VC and is duly identified by the IO.

The parties undertake to abide by the terms of the settlement as also the petitioner further undertakes that he will not interact or contact the respondent No.2 or her family directly or indirectly and will allow her to proceed ahead with her life without any interference.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.393/2019 registered at PS Shakarpur under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
5. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
6. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
